content:
Facts: A totally pretermitted legitimate heir brought an action for reduction against testamentary dispositions assigning the estate to other heirs and sought compensation for occupation of inherited property.
Legal framework
Articles 536 et seq., 554, 561 and 564 of the Italian Civil Code on reserved shares, reduction, fruits and acceptance with benefit of inventory.
Interpretative issue
Whether a totally pretermitted heir must accept the inheritance with benefit of inventory to bring an action for reduction, and how the reserved share and fruits must be calculated.
Principle applied
The value of the estate for purposes of calculating the reserved share must be determined at the time of the opening of the succession, net of the deceased’s debts, and testamentary dispositions are ineffective only within the limits of the actual prejudice suffered by the claimant heir. A totally pretermitted heir is not required to accept the inheritance with benefit of inventory under Article 564 ICC in order to exercise the action for reduction. Co-heirs are entitled to compensation for occupation proportionate to their share from the opening of the succession until division, calculated on the basis of the fair rental value of the property.
